fields.summary: While the queue ran one change set at a time, the orchestrator found that a plain rhiza ls in the main checkout took 0.28 s against 0.03 s for an explicit view. The checkout's current change set was a long-landed one, and openReader, when no view is given, looks up the effective change set's state with w.changeSet, which folds every change set in the log; a landed one then gives the as-is view anyway. The index already stores each change set's state (the change_sets table, read by xi.ChangeSets for view refs). Clearing the current change set by hand brought the read to 0.03 s. Every agent and app read without --view in a worktree with a current change set pays this fold.
fields.title: Milestone 19: default reads stay fast
